note: Ranked improvement backlog for the PSX Trade Desk. Written weekly by the psx-desk-product-scout task (proposes + ranks only, never builds). The owner picks items to implement. score = impact(high3/med2/low1) / effort(high3/med2/low1); higher = do sooner.

items.title: 11 of 44 built Desk Room sessions have never been through the Verifier — and nothing on screen says so
items.why: state/rooms.json: PPL, SNGP, SSGC, CNERGY, GHNI, KEL, SAZEW, PAEL, BAHL, PTC, AIRLINK all carry qa=null (some built as far back as 2026-07-19, 3 weeks unchecked). renderRoom (app.js:2610) only renders the QA transcript turn `room.qa ? ... : ""`, and the reveal-card badge (app.js:3625) only renders `s.qa ? qabadge "QA checked" : ""` — a never-verified room and a Verifier-passed room look IDENTICAL except for one row that's easy to miss. A reader has no way to tell 'this bull/bear case was fact-checked' from 'this bull/bear case was never checked at all'.
items.existing_check: read renderRoom app.js:2600-2630 and the rp-reveal-head badge app.js:3625 — both branch only on truthy/falsy qa, neither has an explicit 'not yet verified' state; confirmed 11 qa=null entries directly in state/rooms.json
items.resolved_note: Fixed 2026-08-09 — renderTranscript's QA turn (app.js:2610) now renders an explicit 'Not yet verified' turn when room.qa is falsy instead of nothing, and the reveal-card badge (app.js:3625) shows qabadge warn 'Not yet verified' instead of omitting the badge. Reuses the existing (previously unused) .qabadge.warn CSS rule in themes.css:481.

items.title: Dossier shows next_earnings dates already in the past
items.why: room-verifier flagged PSO's dossier next_earnings (Jun 18 2026) as stale/already-past vs the 2026-07-16 asof. scripts/build_calendar.py:55-56 already guards `ed >= today` before adding an event to the calendar, but room_dossier.py surfaces the raw fundamentals.next_earnings field with no such guard, so a stale scrape leaks straight to the ticker page.

items.title: Room personas cite a call's price level that's already stale vs the session print
items.why: state/verify.json's claim.price flags fire 36 times across ~12 tickers this cycle (e.g. OGDC: all three personas' turns cite 331.59 vs a 311.95 session price, a ~6% gap), but renderTranscript/renderRoom (dashboard/app.js:2488, 2535) render the persona prose with no inline flag. Distinct from the existing ratio-stale-price-basis item, which is about PE/market-cap calc timing, not a persona's own written price citation.
items.existing_check: grepped renderTranscript/renderRoom (app.js:2488-2650) and the room.qa rendering paths (app.js:2526-2544, 3430, 3444, 5575) — no consumer of verify.json's per-issue claim.price data exists anywhere in app.js

items.title: payout_ratio field recurringly disagrees with the desk's own div_yield/EPS pair
items.why: scripts/fetch_fundamentals.py:26 maps the scraped payoutRatio field straight through with no cross-check. room-verifier had to hand-correct or flag this exact mismatch in 8 of ~22 QA'd tickers this week alone (UBL corrected, NBP corrected, MEBL blocked, HUBC blocked, DCR/LOTCHEM/PSX/DGKC flagged) — a systemic period-basis bug, not one-off scrape noise.
items.resolved_note: Fixed 2026-08-07 — scripts/fetch_fundamentals.py now recomputes payout_ratio as dps/eps instead of trusting the vendor's own payoutRatio field (see module docstring + line ~77). Confirmed live in AKBL's 2026-08-07 room.qa note.

items.title: Fair-value card headlines one blended number while methods disagree 3-4x
items.why: FFC's value card reads '+77.2% undervalued' (state/fairvalue.json) but the 4 underlying methods span Rs381-1,542, driven by an unverified 30% growth_est_pct feeding Graham/DDM — room-verifier caveats this exact dispersion for FFC, DGKC and ATRL this week, but the caveat lives only in fa_memo prose, never on the compact card a skimming user reads first.

items.title: The desk's deterministic per-ticker QA layer (state/verify.json) is computed every cycle and shown nowhere
items.why: scripts/room_verify.py builds state/verify.json every cycle — 390 of 391 tickers carry at least one flag (quant.date staleness, fairvalue.spread disagreement, claim.price mismatch, price_series glitches), including a high_severity list of 4 tickers (LSEVL, MDTL, CLCPS, USVIX) with 'a wrong number may be on screen' price-series glitches, plus an escalate_to_agent list. Only room.qa (the separate LLM Verifier's per-Room-session verdict, which covers just the Room-debated core tickers) is rendered; the full-universe deterministic layer is invisible even for the 4 flagged high-severity names.
items.existing_check: pageTicker (app.js:2553-2650) Promise.all-fetches 24 state files and verify.json is not among them; grepped all of dashboard/app.js and scripts/*.py for 'verify.json' — only scripts/room_verify.py's own doc comment and save_json call reference it, zero consumers

items.title: EPS/valuation figures never disclose consolidated vs unconsolidated basis
items.why: GAL's room qa note this cycle flags an undisclosed consolidated-vs-unconsolidated EPS basis. scripts/fetch_fundamentals.py:24 maps the scraped eps field straight through with no basis tag, and a repo-wide search for consolidated|unconsolidated|basis_note|eps_basis across dashboard/app.js and all scripts/*.py returns zero matches — no field anywhere records which basis feeds PE, fair-value composite, or the fa_memo, for any ticker with both a standalone and group filing.
items.existing_check: rg 'consolidated|unconsolidated|basis_note|eps_basis' dashboard/app.js scripts/*.py — no output; scripts/fetch_fundamentals.py:24 eps mapping (no basis metadata); state/fairvalue.json per-ticker schema (no basis field)

items.title: PE/market-cap sometimes computed off the prior session's close, not today's print
items.why: room-verifier flagged ENGROH (PE 5.22 vs true ~4.99 off a -4.29% session) and MEBL ('same-session price/ratio timestamp mismatch') this week — a same pattern twice suggests fetch_fundamentals and the live price update aren't always ordered/synced within a cycle.

items.title: Signal card 'confidence' pill hides the trade count behind it
items.why: dashboard/app.js:261 renders a green 'high' confidence pill on the board's signal cards; the backtest sample size only appears buried in the thesis prose sentence.
items.resolved_note: Current signal card (app.js:437-451) shows a 'sample n<N>' stat directly in the statgrid, one row below the confidence pill, same card — the trade count is no longer buried in prose. Glossary (app.js:5757) now states this explicitly as a design rule.

items.why: docs/OPERATIONS.md §3c documents the propose-only self-improvement loop but it was internal-only.
